# Stems are GC. The linkers between hairpin-i's outer stem and hairpin-(i+1)'s inner stem.
# e.g. positions 18,19,20 sit between stem (10,17) and stem (21,28).
# In the misfold, 17 pairs with 65, 16 with 66, etc - these are stem positions pairing across.
# To break: make stem positions non-complementary across hairpins. Vary stems: GC, AU, UA, CG.

# hairpin 1: GC/GC, hairpin 2: AU/AU, hairpin 3: CG/CG, hairpin 4: UA/UA, hairpin 5: GC/GC, hairpin 6: AU/AU

# Let's also vary all stems so no cross-complementarity.

loops=[[12,13,14,15],[23,24,25,26],[34,35,36,37],[45,46,47,48],[56,57,58,59],[67,68,69,70]]
for L in loops:
